verdict.rationale: Docs confirm policy and approval workflows exist and can be queried (e.g., 'Unlimited policy and approval workflows', 'Ask questions about policies, approval flows, and flag/decline reasons') and the API can retrieve/update expense records, implying some traceability. However there is no explicit evidence of an immutable audit log, edit-history tracking, or audit-export/compliance certification that would let a finance lead demonstrate a full trail to an external auditor. Missing for 10: dedicated audit-log/history feature, evidence of edit tracking, and any audit-export or compliance certification documentation.
